tasks.preview: deno task compile && cd lib/src && ../../imp preview
tasks.logs: deno task compile && cd lib/src && ../../imp logs
tasks.lint:lib: deno task compile && cd lib/src && ../../imp lint
tasks.perf: deno task compile && deno run -A perf/run.js
tasks.site:build: deno run -A tools/build-site.js && deno task compile && cd lib/src && ../../imp preview --output ../../site/dist/gallery
tasks.site: deno task site:build && deno run -A tools/serve-site.js
tasks.start: deno task compile && cd examples/shell && ../../imp start
tasks.test: deno task test:lib && deno task test:lib:e2e && deno task test:cli
tasks.test:cli: deno task compile && deno test -A cli/test/cli-test.js
tasks.test:cli:update: deno task compile && deno test -A cli/test/cli-test.js -- --update
tasks.test:lib: deno task compile && cd lib/test && ../../imp test --unit
tasks.test:lib:e2e: deno task compile && cd lib/test && ../../imp test --e2e
